description: This file contains benchmarking code for attention bias modules in a transformer model, including experiment configuration, input generation, and performance measurement of custom multi-head attention implementations.

classes.name: ExperimentConfig
classes.description: Holds configuration parameters for a benchmarking experiment, including batch size, number of heads, sequence lengths, embedding dimension, and data type.

classes.name: ExperimentResults
classes.description: Stores timing results for materialized mask and attention mask subclass operations.

classes.name: Experiment
classes.description: Associates a specific configuration with its benchmarking results.

classes.name: CompositeMHA
classes.description: Custom multi-head attention module that performs linear projections, scaled dot-product attention, and output projection.

methods.name: benchmark_torch_function_in_microseconds
methods.description: Runs a function multiple times to warm up and then measures its median execution time in microseconds.

methods.name: ExperimentConfig.head_dim
methods.description: Property that computes the dimension of each attention head.

methods.name: Experiment.asdict
methods.description: Converts the experiment configuration to a dictionary, including head_dim.

methods.name: ExperimentResults.get_entries
methods.description: Returns a list of formatted timing results.

methods.name: Experiment.get_entries
methods.description: Combines configuration and results entries into a list.

methods.name: generate_inputs
methods.description: Creates random input tensors for query, key, and value.

methods.name: CompositeMHA.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the composite multi-head attention module with weights and parameters.

methods.name: CompositeMHA.forward
methods.description: Performs the forward pass of the attention mechanism, including linear projections, scaled dot-product attention, and output projection.

methods.name: CompositeMHA.reset_parameters
methods.description: Initializes the weights of the attention module.

methods.name: run_single_experiment
methods.description: Runs a single benchmarking experiment with a given configuration and returns timing results.

methods.name: generate_experiment_configs
methods.description: Generates a list of different experiment configurations with various parameters.

methods.name: calculate_speedup
methods.description: Calculates the speedup factor between materialized mask time and subclass mask time.

methods.name: print_results
methods.description: Prints a table summarizing experiment results, including max, min, and average speedups.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that runs all experiments and displays results.
